streaming_input.text: Give the exchange an ordinary surface task: have Mara ask whether Jonah has packed yet
, while both avoid naming the goodbye. That practical question lets her wish for him
to stay show through her attention to his departure instead of through direct accusations.
Keep it simple: Mara could ask, “Are you all packed?” and Jonah
could say, “Nearly.” The ordinary question carries her reluctance to let him go
, while his short answer leaves the tension present without making either of them spell it
